expected_form.resumen: Building primary water pump stopped by a burnt-out starter relay; relay replaced and pressure restored on every floor.
expected_form.que_paso: The primary pump had been tripping since early on: it would start, stop after a while, and the upper floors lost pressure; on arrival at the pump room it was stopped completely; the starter relay was burnt out and was replaced with a new one.

timeline.evento: First symptom: the pump starting and stopping, reported by building maintenance
Arrival at the pump room; primary pump fully stopped
Clean start with the new relay; pressure stable on every floor

action_items: Order a spare starter relay (the last one has been used)
Get the building superintendent to sign the service sheet the next day

user_utterances.text: Hello?... I'm done with the building pump job, I'm in the van now, all quiet over here... log the incident report for me.

Well, the primary pump had been tripping since early... it would start, then stop after a while, and the upper floors were losing pressure... I checked the starter relay and it was burnt out, that was it.
The first symptom was around eight ten, when building maintenance called me that it was starting and stopping... log that one.
Then at nine forty I got to the pump room and it was stopped for good, it would just try and nothing.
Nine twenty?... no, it was nine forty... it was almost ten when I got there, nine forty.
That's it... and around eleven oh five the pump was starting fine, with the new relay, and pressure stabilized on every floor.
Well, the primary pump, that's the one that stopped... we never even started the secondary, that one's manual and it's only for emergencies.
That's right, the primary... the secondary wasn't touched at all.
Medium... because it's working again, but it needs watching for a few days.
Wait—... I missed a follow-up: have them order the spare starter relay, the last one has been used... and have the building superintendent sign the service sheet tomorrow.
That's it, good to go... send it.
